title: Clinical Documentation Intervals in the Wound Care Supply Program
content:
# Clinical documentation intervals — Wound Care Supply Program

Clinical documentation standards for each tier of the Wound Care Supply Program.

| Tier | Wound evaluation interval | Over-limit record interval | Surgery or debridement required for coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | 0 (no evaluation requirement) | 0 (not covered) | No |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | 30 days | 30 days | No |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | 30 days | 30 days | No |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | 30 days | 30 days | Yes |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | 30 days | 30 days | Yes |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | 30 days | 30 days | No |

## Definitions

- **Wound evaluation interval** — each shipment requires a practitioner wound evaluation (with wound measurements) dated within this many calendar days before the ship date; 0 means no evaluation requirement.
- **Over-limit record interval** — changes more frequent than the weekly maximum are covered only with a practitioner record of heavy drainage or infection dated within this many calendar days before the ship date; 0 means not covered.
- **Surgery or debridement required** — whether dressings are covered only for a wound caused by or treated by a surgical procedure, or debrided, as documented by the practitioner.

## Notes

- Every insured tier uses the same 30-day evaluation interval and the same 30-day over-limit record interval.
- Coverage limited to a surgical or debrided wound applies on the two Medicare tiers, the Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program and the Wound Care Original Medicare Program.
